Usage: shadcn registry validate [options] [registry]

validate a shadcn registry

Arguments:
  registry         registry address to validate. Supports registry.json paths
                   and GitHub sources. (default: "./registry.json")

Options:
  -c, --cwd <cwd>  the working directory. defaults to the current directory.
                   (default: "/project")
  -h, --help       display help for command
